hebrewText: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה יְרֵאִים֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֶת פְּסִֽילֵי/הֶ֖ם הָי֣וּ עֹֽבְדִ֑ים גַּם בְּנֵי/הֶ֣ם וּ/בְנֵ֣י בְנֵי/הֶ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָ/ם֙ הֵ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)

tokens.kjv: he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which.
